items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: other guys who went there for like a month and dropped out and became legends like Miles

ctx.x: I just would like to ask you if you wanted to leave a word with students that you knew would be watching this interview, things that you could tell them about music, to put the magic in it, what would you tell them? ©Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

Well clinics don’t like to hire me because what I have to say I say in about 15-20 seconds. You learn the basics and you get out in the world. You know you learn what the music’s about, and that’s it. It ain’t about schoolwork, you know it ain’t about nothing like that, you know. And if you want it bad enough you’ll get it. Everybody doesn’t accomplish those ends, you know what I mean? But if that’s what you want to do, that’s what you do. Some guys go to institutes of higher learning and they, like your…
